book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: JA' AN CARTA TET EB CREYENTE HEBREO

content: Ja' Wan Xaambal Jix Ak'lei, C'am Chi El Cu Penail Yu
Ja' sley naj Moisés, asan echele ye yu wan tzet yetal ja' caw. Yutol ja' jun ley tu', c'am che ske' swa'xi oc sna'bal eb chi yoche chi apni sattaj Dios yu wan xaambal chi ak'le jun jun jabil tu'.
K'inaloj ta chi wa'xi oc sna'bal eb yu wan xaambal tu', c'am xam sowalil wanoj xa xaambal. K'inaloj ta yel chi sajbi el eb yin spenail yet chi yak'on xaambal eb tu', man xam penawom oj eb chi yabe.
Jaj xa xin, ja' wan xaambal eb tu' chi ak'on sna'ontej spenail eb yin jun jun jabil.
Yutol ja' ẍiq'uil no' icham wacax tu', c'al yetoj ẍiq'uil no' ach'e chiw tu', c'am chi ske' yi'on el cu penail.
Yu jun tu', yuxan ja' yet jix jul Cristo bey yul yiban k'inal ti', jix yal tet cu Mam Dios jaxca ti':

content.text: C'am cha woche xaambal, c'al wan no' nok' chi ak'le e ach. Yuxan jix ja wak' wa'xoj jun jin mimanil an.
C'am chi tzala ja c'ul yetoj wan xaambal chi yak' eb yu spenail.
Yuxan jix wal e ach jaxca ti': “Ti' ey jin an jaach Dios, yet watx' chi wak' ja na'bal oj, jaxca jix tz'ibele can jin k'aneal yul An Juun,” ẍi Cristo.

content: Ja' yet sbabelal, jaxca ti' jix yute yaloni, tol c'am chi yoche Dios wan xaambal tu', c'al wan no' nok' chi ak'le tet tu', c'al wan no' nok' chi yak' tz'a' eb yu spenail tu'. Cax c'al chi yal ley, tol chi ak'le wan tu' tet Dios, pero ma tzala sc'ul yetoj eb.

Catu' jix yalon pax Cristo tu' jaxca ti': “Ti' ey jin an, jaach Dios, yet watx' chi wak' ja na'bal oj an,” ẍi Cristo tu'. Chi yal yel oc apnoj tol jix lawi yopiso wan xaambal tu'. Catu' jix yak'on jun xa xaambal yin sq'uexel oj wan tu'.
Yutol ja' Jesucristo tu', yu jix yun jaxca sna'bal Dios, yuxan chi el cu penail, yutol jix yak' ja' caw smimanil naj Jesús yin xaambalil yin junelne.
Masanil eb yak'omal xaambal ket conob tet Dios, jaxca c'al ti' yilon yopiso eb jun jun c'u, yet chi yak'on wan xaambal eb tu'. Pero ja' wan xaambal tu', c'am chi ske' yi'on el cu penail.
Jal naj Jesucristo xin, jun ch'an xaambal jix yak' yu cu penail yin junelne. Jix lawi jun tu' xin, catu' jix to ey chotan naj bey swatx' k'ab Dios.
Ja' titu' lalan yechbanen naj masanta' c'al chi can can eb scajat yalan yu Dios.
Yu jun xaambal jix yak' naj tu', yuxan jix cu tz'ajna el yin junelne, yutol jix i'le el cu penail yu.
Chi yak' sba Santo Espíritu testigoal e on yin wan ti'. Yutol jix yal yin sbabelal jaxca ti':

content.text: Ja' yet oj lawoj jun tiempoal tu'. Oj jin wa'ne jun ac' trato yetoj eb an. Oj waoc jin chejbanil yin spixan eb an, ẍi naj Kaawil tu' yul An Juun.

content: Catu' jix yalon pax jaxca ti':

content.text: C'am xa bak'in oj jin na'tej smul eb, c'al spenail eb an, ẍi naj.

content: Yuxan, ja' yet chi ak'le lawoj cu penail yu naj tu', c'am xa sowalil chi kak' cu xaambal yu cu penail tu'.
Yuxan, manchej cu xiw koctoj, jex wuẍtaj, jex wanab bey jun lugar asan Dios ey yet xojli. Yutol yu ẍiq'uil naj Jesucristo chi ske' koctoj.
Chi ske' cu to yul jun be yet k'inale jix sjaj can naj e on yet jix tz'ilchatoj jun an k'ap. Ja' jun an k'ap tu', laan jaxca smimanil Cristo.
Ey jun yaawil yak'omal cu xaambal tet Dios, jaon uninale jon xa ti'.

Yuxan cu jitz wej toj cu ba sc'atan Dios tu' yin masanil cu c'ul. Ka wej oc yin cu c'ul sic'lebil. Yutol sajbanebil xa cu pixan yu, yet watx' c'am xa tzet man watx' oj ey oc yin cu na'bal. Catu' sajbanebil xa cu mimanil yetoj jun ja' ja' caw saj.
Tec'an chi kute kaon oc jun cu cuybanil ti' yip oj cu c'ul. C'am ojab cu caab c'ulal, yutol ja' Dios, oj yun c'al ta' tzet jix yal can e on.
Cu sey tzet chi kute kiptzelen cu ba, yet watx' chi ch'ib cu cam c'ulal, catu' chi wa'xi oc cu beybal.
Manchej cu bej can cu yamban cu ba, jaxca sbeybal wanoj xa eb. Sowalil chi kiptzele wej cu ba. Kak' wej kip, yutol lalan kilon wan yechel chi x'ox sba tol jayebxane c'ual catu' oj jul naj Kaawil.
Ja' tinani', kotaj xa jun cuybanile caw yel. Yuxan ta ja'c'ala' chi el kunen tzet yetal tol kotaj tol man watx' oj, c'am xa junoj xa xaambal chi ske' scam yu cu penail tu'.
Ta jaxca tu', asanxane jun sya'ilal ey smey chi kechbane, ch'al tu', c'al k'ak' k'ak' chi nilxi xaj. Smoo chi cu xiw tet. Ja' jun k'ak' k'ak' tu' oj ak'on lawoj el eb cajat oc yin Dios.
Ta ey mac c'am chi jijen sley Moisés, catu' ta ey pax cawan oj ma oxwan oj testigo chi iloni, tol c'am chi sjije, tool c'al scam eb. C'am mac txequel chi ske' yok' sc'ul yin eb.

Jaxa tinani', ta chi kintajne can el naj Sc'aal Dios, ta c'am yel oc apnoj ẍiq'uil naj yul cu sat, ta chi ki' el sq'uixwil Yespíritu Dios chi cu cam c'ulneni, ¿jantaj to sya'ilal oj cu cha' yintaj eb ma jijen sley Moisés tu'? Yutol yu ẍiq'uil tu', yuxan jix yak' strato Dios ketoj. Yuxan tz'ajan jix el cu penail kiban.

Kotaj tol jaxca ti' yalon can naj Kaawil, “Jain ey walon wet wak'on sya'ilal eb. Jain oj wak' spaj tet eb an,” ẍi naj. Catu' chi yalon pax jaxca ti': “oj jin na' oc yin jin conob, jain Yaaw jin ti' an,” ẍi naj.
Caw ey smey sna'le oc kin yu cu penail yu jun Dios iquis.
Pero na' wej tej yet yalantoj, yet jix je cha'on saj k'inal yin je pixan yin sbabelal. Caw tec'an jix je yute je ba xol sya'tajilal.
Ila tol ey jex jix jex buchlei, ey jex jix jex etnele sattaj conob. Ey jex, yet jix je yil yoc sya'tajilal yiban eb. Jun laan jix yun je yaben sya'ilal yetoj eb.

Caw jix ok' je c'ul yin eb jix oc preso. Jix techa je yu yet jix i'le ec' je tzettaj yetal. Jix tzala a je c'ul yet jix je yabeni, tol ey je tzettaj yetal bey satcan tol tx'oj xa wal swatx'il tet tzet jix i'le ec' e ex tu'. Catu' c'am chi lawi el oj.
Yu jun tu', yuxan tec'an c'al che yute je ba, yutol oj je cha' mimej spaj.
Sowalil miman che yute je c'ul yet watx' oj ske' je yunen masanil tzet chi ẍa' sc'ul Dios. Catu' oj je cha'on tzet yalnaj can e ex tu'.
Yutol chi yal yul An Juun jaxca ti':

content.text: Txenxane wal, catu' chi jul jun mac sowalil oj jul oj, c'am chi ec' tiempo yuli.
Ja' eb jichan chi yute sba, oj ey ey ec' eb yutol chin yaoc eb yin sc'ul an. Pero ta chi meltzo eb yintaj, c'am xa chin tzala yetoj eb an, ẍi yul An Juun.

content: Pero jaonti', manaj jon chi cu meltzo kintaj jaxca eb chi meltzo yintaj tu', catu' chi q'uey can el eb yin junelne. Yutol jaonti', chi kaoc yin cu c'ul, yuxan colchanaj jon xa.
